name: prefeitura-mg-par-de-minas-certid-o-negativa-de-d-bitos
description: This MCP server allows AI agents to query municipal tax clearance certificates (Certidão Negativa de Débitos) from the Prefeitura of Pará de Minas, MG, in a read-only manner. It provides a single tool for checking debts from official sources with prepaid usage.
